review_type: source-grounded AI review; not physician adjudication
reviewed_components: all clinical facts and measured quantities
corrections: p1-f017 procedure name "Breast and axillary ultrasound" corrected to "Axillary ultrasound"; the source names only an ultrasound of the axillary mass.
Maximum relative infant dose 0.091% (comparator <=) now also cites the Discussion restatement in b00049.
Event p1-e14 reworded so the not_occurred plan reads as the hormonal therapy itself (not recommended), removing a double negative.
Event time classifications: e09 "2 weeks after delivery" precision exact; e11 "after the 9th week" precision approximate; e13 "Following the completion of chemotherapy" time_kind order_only.
Added relation e10 before e13: breast milk expressed and discarded "until chemotherapy was completed" and radiotherapy "Following the completion of chemotherapy" (same anchor, both quoted).
Added relation e11 before e12: the relative infant dose is calculated "Based on" the 27 h breast milk concentration (result to calculation).
Added ambiguity: abstract says milk levels drop below the minimum quantifiable dose at 72 h, Results/Table 1 give 71.25 h; treated as abstract approximation, not a conflict.
Corrected article limitation that wrongly called the 71.25 and 75.75 h samples quantified.
unresolved: Figures 1 to 3 plot the same concentrations printed in Table 1; plot points are not read, only printed table values and text values are recorded.

The relative infant dose uses a population 50th centile infant weight estimate, not a measured infant weight, and a standard daily milk volume of 150 mL/kg per the formula; the formula image has no resolved asset.
Table 1 time labels and the text sampling times differ in places (2.75 h versus 3 h, plasma 6.5 and 8.5 h not tabulated, a 193 h row not in the text list); see ambiguities.
Time of each concentration is the Table 1 row label in hours; the table does not state the reference point, and the Results/abstract state hours following chemotherapy for some values only.
Table cells that are blank (plasma after 6 h, milk before 3 h) are not reported and are not recorded as zero or missing results.
Whether the sampled dose was the 9th weekly dose, and the number of paclitaxel cycles delivered after the pause, are not stated explicitly.

The abstract and Results give 72 h as the time of the maximum relative infant dose; the milk samples at 71.25 and 75.75 h are below the minimum quantifiable concentration and 72 h is not a listed sampling time.

key_findings: Single index patient (33-year-old woman, breast cancer in pregnancy); roster count 1 from the singular case statement.

Text vs Table 1 time labels (milk 2.75 h vs 3 h row, plasma 6.50/8.50 h listed but 3/6 h rows printed, 193 h row absent from the text list) are ambiguities: the source never ties a specific row to a different-labelled sample, so no single measurement has two values.
2050 ng/mL (text, peak at 1 h) vs 2050.92 (Table 1, 1 h) is a rounding difference; both kept as items with an ambiguity.
Merges at milk 27 h (6.83 ng/mL) and 71.25 h (<mqc, text <2.5 ng/mL) are supported: same specimen, same stated time point, same value in text and table.
<mqc cells: "<" from the cell, 2.5 ng/mL from the governing Table 1 footnote; LC/MS/MS method from the breast milk assay paragraph, applied to milk items only (plasma items carry no method).
Nine weekly paclitaxel cycles in total, six before the pause at 36 weeks: consistent counts, not a conflict.
Radiotherapy dose 50 Gray in 25 fractions is kept in the evidence quote; neither procedures_devices nor oncology.treatments has a dose field.
Figures 1-3 are line graphs without printed data labels; visual.json has no readings or plot estimates.
residual_risks: Table 1 time labels may be shifted against the Methods sampling times; time attributes of plasma 3 h and 6 h and milk 3 h rows are as printed.
Hormonal therapy non-recommendation is encoded as care plan assertion absent / action_status recommended and a not_occurred plan event.
Relative infant dose inputs include a population-centile infant weight estimate, recorded as an estimate.
Equation graphic has no declared asset and was not viewed.
